title: Europe 2026 Travel Guide
philosophy: Architecture and beautiful neighborhoods over museums
Walking and wandering rather than rushing between attractions
Great food, wine, cocktails, and local beer
A relaxed pace with cafés and people-watching
Hidden local gems mixed with a few iconic sights
No more than one organized activity per day
Strategic use of trams, funiculars, Bolt, Uber, and taxis instead of unnecessary hill climbing
Skip rather than rush when the day becomes too full
operationalRule: Protect the reservation and the group’s energy. Skip the optional sight, take the Bolt, sit for the coffee, and arrive at dinner feeling human.

globalNotices.title: Bordeaux host schedule is tentative
globalNotices.body: Bordeaux activities are supplied by the host and should not be treated as confirmed reservations.

globalNotices.title: Laundry plan
globalNotices.body: Pack for repeat outfits. Plan laundry at the end of Bordeaux or the beginning of Lisbon.
